- Large irregular tan-brown necrotic areas (upper half completely desiccated/crumbling)

- Shot holes where dead tissue has fallen out
- Green healthy tissue still visible at leaf base

**Reference comparison:**
- **Early Blight (Bugwood_18):** Shows widespread brown necrosis across many leaves with yellow transitions — closest overall match to the advanced-stage damage in the test image
- **Late Blight (Bugwood_58):** Shows darker, almost black wilted/shriveled tissue — too dark and wet-looking compared to the tan-dry necrosis in the test image
- **Target Spot:** Small discrete spots — not matching large coalesced necrosis
- **Septoria Leaf Blotch:** Small spots on mostly green leaf — not matching
- **Phytophthora Blight:** Stem cankers — not matching leaf symptoms

The test image's large, dry, tan-brown irregular necrotic areas with yellow margins and shot holes is most consistent with **Early Blight** at an advanced stage where lesions have coalesced across much of the leaf surface.
